for: UnlockPlan P0 existing FastAPI + Vite frontend

routes.purpose: backend health, no user-specific farm info
server-maintained source registry and operational-rule provenance
attributed live/cached/stale/unavailable Open-Meteo precipitation model forecast
rules: Only retrieved_live/cached_recent may be used for selectable current forecast hours
Stale is not current; unavailable is not zero rainfall
Never show synthetic values as live weather

routes.purpose: Python engine outcome based on farmer-declared constraints
compare independently declared before and after cases
replan using selected source-attested current forecast hour; returns 409 if current forecast unavailable

frontend_card_connections.deadline: user selected local time; optional forecast hour
frontend_card_connections.changes: packages returned by /api/evaluate; compare via POST /api/compare
frontend_card_connections.summary: original and revised backend results, not a fictional history

source_caveats: No auth or saved farmer accounts
No automatic crop thresholds, guaranteed safety or yield claims
No real multilingual AI/voice/translation backend in this contract
